items.title: Melbourne aged care COVID outbreak back in spotlight
items.description: An inquest examining 50 COVID-era deaths at a Melbourne aged care home has resumed after a years-long hiatus.

items.title: State disability ministers lash NDIS overhaul
items.description: State and territory disability ministers have accused the Albanese government of pushing on with NDIS reform that does not align with previous agreements.

items.title: Ebola outbreak grows to almost 600 confirmed cases
items.description: In just two weeks the number of confirmed Ebola virus cases has increased more than eightfold, with at least 100 people now dead.

items.title: Consumer watchdog warns real estate agents must not misrepresent homes
items.description: Real estate agents selling homes must not misrepresent information about the builder or serious defects, SA's consumer watchdog has said, after eight builders were hit with public warning notices over their conduct in the state.

items.title: Culture in Australia's largest police force 'unacceptable'
items.description: Bullying, discrimination and sexual harassment are occurring at "unacceptable levels" within the NSW Police Force and employees are too afraid to speak up, an independent report has found.

items.title: Stabbing victim's family calls for calm amid violent protests in Northern Ireland
items.description: The family of a Northern Irish man who lost an eye in a knife attack has appealed for calm ​after anti-immigrant violence in Belfast.

items.title: Notorious Sydney gang rapist Mohammed Skaf facing drug charges
items.description: NSW Police arrested the 42-year-old in Greenacre in Sydney's south-west overnight and he has been charged with 24 offences.

items.title: Massive whale graveyard found in deep ocean off Australia
items.description: Hundreds of whale fossils, including those from extinct species new to science, range in age from recent to 5 million years old and are also home to undescribed deep-sea creatures.

items.title: Albanese's frustration with Trump is becoming harder to hide
items.description: The Albanese government is paying an economic and political toll for an ongoing and deeply unpopular war.

items.title: Live: Iran vows to turn Strait of Hormuz into 'hell' after US launches more strikes
items.description: The US military says it has launched a series of strikes on "multiple targets" in Iran. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
